verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ מָחֲלַ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ נָבָ֣ל אָ֘מַ֤ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְהִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- mā·ḥă·laṯ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ nā·ḇāl ’ā·mar bə·lib·bōw ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm hiš·ḥî·ṯū wə·hiṯ·‘î·ḇū ‘ā·wel ’ên ‘ō·śêh- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Mahalath A Maskil of David The fool says in his heart [There is] no God They are corrupt their ways are vile There is no one who does good

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים הִשְׁקִ֪יף מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ עַֽל־ בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm hiš·qîp̄ miš·šā·ma·yim ‘al- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām lir·’ō·wṯ hă·yêš maś·kîl dō·rêš ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand if any seek - God

verses.original: כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lōw sāḡ yaḥ·dāw ne·’ĕ·lā·ḥū ’ên ‘ō·śêh- ṭō·wḇ ’ên gam- ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: All have turned away they have together become corrupt there is no one who does good not even one

verses.original: פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen hă·lō yā·ḏə·‘ū ’ō·ḵə·lê ‘am·mî ’ā·ḵə·lū le·ḥem lō qā·rā·’ū ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Will the workers of iniquity never learn They devour my people [like] bread they refuse to call upon God

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם׀ פָּֽחֲדוּ־ פַחַד֮ הָ֪יָה֫ לֹא־ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šām pā·ḥă·ḏū- p̄a·ḥaḏ hā·yāh lō- p̄ā·ḥaḏ kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm piz·zar ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ḥō·nāḵ hĕ·ḇi·šō·ṯāh kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm mə·’ā·sām
verses.literal: There they are overwhelmed with dread [where] there was nothing to fear For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you You put them to shame for God has despised them

verses.original: מִ֥י יְשֻׁע֪וֹת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּשׁ֣וּב שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יָגֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ יִשְׂמַ֥ח
verses.transliteration: mî yə·šu·‘ō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl yit·tên miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·šūḇ šə·ḇūṯ ‘am·mōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ yā·ḡêl yiś·rā·’êl yiś·maḥ
verses.literal: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion When God restores His captive people let Jacob rejoice let Israel be glad
